title: Workspace sweep: align extension-server backend.rs re-export rustdoc to richest sibling (sharing-server)
description:
## Scope

Workspace cookie-cutter alignment. The 8 extension-server crates currently have inconsistent rustdoc richness on the module-level explanation of their backend.rs re-exports:

| Crate | Richness |
|---|---|
| jmap-sharing-server | RICHEST — has 'About the re-exports' section with version-pinning + discoverability paragraphs |
| jmap-metadata-server | RICH — has version-pinning paragraph (added under bd:JMAP-ayoz.25, 2026-05-16) |
| jmap-tasks-server | EXPLICIT one-liner — 'so a consumer can write use jmap_tasks_server::backend::* and get the full vocabulary in one import' |
| jmap-mail-server (CANONICAL) | TERSE — 'they are re-exported here for convenience' |
| jmap-chat-server | TERSE — same as mail-server |
| jmap-calendars-server | NONE — no rationale text at all |
| jmap-contacts-server | TERSE — same as mail-server |
| jmap-filenode-server | NONE — only says 're-exports' in module title |

The canonical-template rule (workspace AGENTS.md) says siblings mirror mail-server. Here two siblings (sharing-server, metadata-server) are RICHER than the canonical, which is backwards.

## Fix

Upgrade jmap-mail-server canonical's backend.rs module-level rustdoc to match the richest sibling (sharing-server's 'About the re-exports' shape, including version-pinning paragraph). Then propagate the same rustdoc to the 6 sparser siblings (chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode — and metadata-server can stay since it already has the richer version).

## Acceptance

- All 8 extension-server backend.rs files carry equivalent rustdoc richness on the re-export rationale
- mail-server (canonical) is the source of truth — siblings mirror it byte-for-byte modulo the spec-specific names
- cargo doc -D warnings green on each crate
- No code change — pure doc edits

## Why P4

Pure doc consistency. No behaviour change, no API surface change. Bumps from bd:JMAP-ayoz.25 closure that observed but did not address the workspace-wide divergence.

## Cross-references

- Driving bead: bd:JMAP-ayoz.25 (closed)
- Workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' rule
- Sibling sweep: bd:JMAP-ejhk (similar register_*_handlers rustdoc propagation)
